body:
alex: Heads-up — proposing a quantile-based canary gate to replace fixed-step percent ramps. Lower-risk for tail-latency regressions.

mira: quick sketch?

alex: Idea: instead of a sequence of % traffic steps, advance traffic until p95/p99 are within a configured delta of baseline for a stability window. If p99 exceeds threshold -> pause and either hold or rollback.

sam: So policy looks like: { "kind": "quantile_gate", "metric": "p99_latency", "window": "5m", "delta": 0.15, "min_samples": 200 } ?

jordan: love it. How does this interact with A/B control groups? we need sample size calculation and multiple-cohort handling.

alex: We'll compute required sample size per cohort. For latency we'll favor bootstrap/resampling over parametric formulas because distributions are heavy-tailed.

mira: UX idea: Console shows live quantile traces with shaded baseline band, predicted time-to-safe based on current traffic rate, and an "auto-advance when safe" toggle. Also an explicit "manual step by X%" control.

sam: API debate: current rollout schema only supports numeric "step_percent" array. Proposal: extend to optional "gate" object while keeping old format backward-compatible. Example extension:

```json
{
  "stages": [
    { "type": "percent", "pct": 5, "duration": "10m" },
    { "type": "gate", "gate": { "kind": "quantile", "metric": "p99_latency", "delta": 0.12, "window": "10m", "min_samples": 500 } }
  ]
}
```

jordan: Also need deterministic fallback routing: if the new model variant fails the gate, route remaining traffic to pinned fallback model id, not just pause.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for model v3 -> v4 at 2589012345

alex: Also add cooldown after any pause: enforce a hold for 3x the observation window to gather fresh stats before re-advancing.

mira: Concern: low-traffic tenants will never reach min_samples. Proposal: require either an absolute sample floor OR an opt-in synthetic replay mode that can be toggled per-customer.

sam: For A/B tests we keep percent splits as-is but use per-cohort gates. Gate decision made only when each cohort hits its sample threshold.

jordan: Edge case: unrelated infra noise (noisy hosts, infra upgrades) can trigger false positives. Suggest composite conditions: metric delta AND infra_error_rate < threshold AND cluster_cpu_ok.

alex: agreed. We'll add configurable composite predicates and a short-circuit rule for infra anomalies to mark results as inconclusive.

mira: Next steps: PR for API schema + console mockups + telemetry dashboards. Assigning @sam for API, @jordan for telemetry, @mira for UX.

sam: I'll open a WIP PR and link here.

alex: Also please add a short doc blurb for SRE: deterministic rollback triggers and how alerts map to canary state.

jordan: I'll add dashboard panels, alert rules, and a replay tool for low-traffic customers.

deploy-bot: PR 4821 created by sam: follow-up on quantile gates — https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4821 :eyes: 

mira: rough ETA for visually complete console flow — EOW?

sam: EOW for API schema, full implementation EOM unless blockers.

alex: Small NOTE: quantile gating may extend rollout duration for large customers; we should include an explicit SLA note and an opt-out for time-sensitive upgrades.

mira: ok will add copy and an inline risk indicator.

sam: ping if anyone wants a prototype example rollout config to test.

alex: thanks all, let's keep the gate config conservative for the first rollout.
